title: Lieut. Frederick Duke Yonge

---

cousin of CMY

Son of the Rev.

Duke Yonge, Vicar of Antony, he was dismissed in disgrace for going AWOL 1855, emigrated to New Zealand, married (1859) Charlotte Andrews (d. 1922), and has living descendants.
